resumeText:
Sneha Kulkarni | Pune | sneha.k@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Zoho Developer, Sahyadri Cloud Solutions, Pune (2021 - present)
- Built 12 Zoho Creator apps for order tracking, field service and vendor onboarding for small business clients.
- Wrote Deluge custom functions and scheduled scripts to sync invoices between Zoho CRM and Zoho Books.
- Configured Zoho CRM blueprints, custom modules and workflow rules for a 60-person sales team.
- Integrated Zoho apps with a courier platform and an online store through REST APIs and webhooks.
- Migrated 40,000 customer records from spreadsheets into Zoho CRM with field mapping and duplicate checks.

SKILLS
Zoho Creator, Deluge, Zoho CRM, Zoho Books, Requirement gathering, REST APIs

EDUCATION
BCA, Savitribai Phule Pune University, 2021
